about: The wordings of how a question stands today (question-names.json) that complain about how things are, for the side that is defending what is in force. A defending speaker is never asked 'Why would we change course, when' a complaint (the second reader, Nov 14: the sentence argues for the thing the speaker is against). TUNABLE reading, by the Speeches builder, Nov 14; every other wording of a defending side is a plain or good one.
